description: The conceptual idea with 100% Clustered Stacked Column Chart is to compare multiple data series grouped by a common category. Further compare individual segments or component parts within an individual column, where each column sums to 100%. Common use cases- Finance: Actual vs Budget/Forecast spend within a given month; Actual spend further segmented by spend type. Sales and Marketing: Product lines contribution to its revenue, Current Year vs Prior Year, for different regions This visual is free forever in Power BI Desktop.
